IBM’s 2022 Form 10-K income statement presents total revenue of $60,530 million for 2022 and $55,179 million for 2020 (with Kyndryl treated as discontinued operations). [DOC: ibm_fy2022_income_statement.txt]  

The notes explain that, following the November 3, 2021 separation of Kyndryl, “the historical results of Kyndryl have been presented as discontinued operations in these consolidated financial statements,” meaning the 2020 revenue shown in the 2022 filing is restated and not directly comparable to the originally reported 2020 revenue of $73,620 million in IBM’s 2020 Form 10-K. [DOC: ibm_fy2022_notes.txt; ibm_fy2020_10k.txt]

Because of the discontinued-operations restatement, the directly comparable revenue figures for 2020 and 2022 are those presented together in the 2022 Form 10-K:  
- 2020 revenue (restated, continuing operations basis): $55,179 million [DOC: ibm_fy2022_income_statement.txt]  
- 2022 revenue: $60,530 million [DOC: ibm_fy2022_income_statement.txt]

Using these comparable figures, revenue growth from 2020 to 2022 is:

\[
\text{Growth} = \frac{60{,}530 - 55{,}179}{55{,}179} \approx 9.7\%
\]

[DOC: ibm_fy2022_income_statement.txt]

ANSWER: Approximately 9.7% revenue growth from fiscal 2020 to fiscal 2022 (on a continuing-operations, post-Kyndryl-separation basis).
